verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order by putting "$3" above "2 FOR". Its logo pill and Find a Store button are shrunk to near-illegible chips and jammed together at the bottom edge, and the right third of the canvas is dead space. B reads left to right in the right order (brand, can, "2 FOR", "$3", CTA), but its logo pill is bloated, competes with "$3" and sits tight to the left edge. B's body copy also wraps to an orphaned "long.", and its CTA is small in the bottom-right corner.
